name: kerosene + sulfur + thuja occidentalis leafy twig
purpose: USES Temporarily relieves itching eruptions of the skin, as in ringworm or athlete's foot.
uses: INDICATIONS PETROLEUM Nausea SULPHUR Skin problems THUJA OCC Warts
otcwarn: STOP USE AND ASK DOCTOR If symptoms persist or recur, discontinue use. If pregnant or nursing, consult a licensed practitioner before using this product.
